title: Mixed Event — Run! Sports Festival! Committee Rush — Episode4 With My Senpai

meta.Event Outline: Saki invites Haruka to join the Sports Festival Planning Committee. Together with fellow committee member Emu, they strive to make the Sports Festival a fun and joyful event, but how will it turn out?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's see... Practice for the three-legged race is supposed to be here...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And what was the name of the girl I'm partnered with again?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? Have we met before somewhere...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't get the chance to speak with many first years outside of club activities. It's nice to meet you, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's nice to meet you too!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Friend A
rows.Line: Hey, Mafuyu! Good luck in the three-legged race!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's nothing like that. But it is nice to have them cheering me on.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Friend A
rows.Line: Mafuyu's amazing! Not only is she super smart and great at school, she's really athletic. She's in the big relay race too, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thanks. Otori and I will do our best.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are you sure? If there's something on your mind, don't hesitate to ask.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Wh-What is this?! She's smiling but it doesn't feel like she's smiling...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Shall we get started, then? First we tie our shoes together with a figure-8 knot and...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That looks like Emu with... Ms. Asahina? The second year?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Emu, you and Ms. Asahina are partners for the three-legged race. Good luck!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is she a friend of yours?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, uh... Yes!
We're in the same class...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I heard a lot of the girls here look up to Ms. Asahina because she's so cute, gets really high grades and is even good at sports.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Emu must be one of them too.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Congratulations on getting such a great partner, Emu. I'll be cheering for you two!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. That was a kind thing for her to say.
Sports Festival - One day to go

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, KAITO... It's been a while since Emu last visited, hasn't it?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. Tsukasa and the others mentioned that Emu has been busy preparing for a Sports Festival.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What, really?! Does that mean I won't be able to see her for a while?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No fair! No fair! I want to see Emu!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Don't worry. I'm sure she'll come visit as soon as things calm down after her Sports Festival.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Besides, we have our own show to prepare for, Miku. I'll see you at rehearsal.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But...
I want to sing and dance with Emu...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm? This feeling. Could it be...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're here! When I heard you were busy with your Sports Festival, I was worried I wouldn't get to see you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You were? Sorry I haven't been here lately.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I was just thinking that it's been a while since I got to see you too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But the Sports festival is tomorrow! I'm so excited that I haven't been able to sleep!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And because of something a little scary that happened too...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What kinds of stuff are you doing for your Sports Festival, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Well, there's the big relay race, the cavalry battle, the ball toss and a bunch of other stuff too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone on the planning committee has been working super hard to get ready♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That sounds like so much fun...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I want to be part of your Sports Festival too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sign-ups for all the events closed a while ago...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I guess trying to join this late would be pretty hard, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I still wish you could come with me, Miku. I wonder if there's anything we can do...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
What if I went as part of your cheer squad?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can call your name and wave flags around and stuff♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's a great idea!
I'd love to have you there cheering me on♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hurray! I'll see you tomorrow at your school's Sports Festival then!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: If you're there cheering me on, I'll be able to give it a million percent!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Today's the day.
I'm glad the weather is so nice too.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It feels almost like I'm about to do a show.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm going to do my best so everyone can look back on today and remember it as a fun day.
